PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 10, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55765  Recommendation to approve June 26, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55766  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for July 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55768  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal for the Rehabilitation of Sewer Lift
  Stations S-19, S-28, and S-29 Project (SC-0510), and award a contract to JIG
  Consultants in the amount not to exceed $783,040 for a period of one year, and
  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into
  the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55769  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute License
  Agreement with Southern California Edison Company (SCE), allowing the Long
  Beach Public Utilities Department (LBPUD) to access an SCE right-of-way located
  east of the San Gabriel River, both north and south of East Willow Street, for
  reclaimed water pipeline and fiber optic conduit purposes, for a term of five years
  from August 1, 2025 to July 31, 2030.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 10, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  25-55770  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal UD-25-246 for GIS Migration to
  Utility Network and award a contract with DCSE, Inc. in a total amount of
  $310,920, with a contingency of $47,000, for a total not-to-exceed amount of
  $357,920 for a period of two years and authorize the General Manager to execute
  all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55771  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposals UD-24-210 for Cathodic
  Protection Deep Well Abandonment and award a contract to Accurate Corrosion
  Control Inc., of Glendale, AZ, in a total contract amount not to exceed $200,000 for
  a period of one year with the option to renew for two additional one year periods,
  and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter
  into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55772  Recommendation to approve the Amended Water Supply Assessment prepared
  for the Sea Ranch Business Park Project pursuant to California Water Code
  Sections 10910 through 10914.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-55773  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement, and
  any subsequent necessary amendments, with the U.S. Cybersecurity and
  Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) to conduct cybersecurity assessments of the
  Long Beach Public Utilities Department’s computer networks.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-55775  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1541 correcting scrivener’s errors in
  Resolution No. UT-1536, a resolution fixing rates and charges for the gas services
  to all customers.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-55776  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the Sewer System Management
  Plan (SSMP) Self-Audit (2021-2024).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 25-55777  Recommendation to receive and file the Water Resources Plan update.

  Page 2 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 10, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-55778  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report for
  May and June 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call
the Board of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-
6626 (telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA

  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
